_: Players the board prices who cannot play a full 2026 season as of asOf: injured reserve,
PUP, suspension, the commissioner's exempt list. gamesOut is regular-season games the
player is expected to miss (17 = out for the year). `season` is the full-season stat
line captured from PROJECTIONS the first time the entry was applied; the committed row
is season x (17 - gamesOut) / 17. To reinstate a player set gamesOut to 0 and re-run
(the season line comes back), then delete the entry after the next projections merge.
Apply with `node tools/apply-availability.mjs`; CI runs it with --check.
